Resolutions of 1978

21 resolutions, 33% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 423 (1978) Declaring illegal any internal settlement of the Southern Rhodesia question
  • 424 (1978) Southern Rhodesia's armed invasion of Zambia
  • 425 (1978) Establishment of a UN interim force for Southern Lebanon
  • 426 (1978) Establishment of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 427 (1978) Strengthening of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon and withdrawal of Israeli forces from Lebanon
  • 428 (1978) South African military activities against Angola
  • 429 (1978) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 430 (1978) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 431 (1978) Requesting the Secretary-General to appoint a Special Representative for Namibia
  • 432 (1978) Territorial integrity of Namibia and reintegration of Walvis Bay into Namibia
  • 433 (1978) Admission of Solomon Islands to membership in the United Nations
  • 434 (1978) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 435 (1978) Establishment of the UN Transition Assistance Group for Namibia
  • 436 (1978) A cease-fire in Lebanon
  • 437 (1978) Observation of sanctions against Southern Rhodesia
  • 438 (1978) Renewal of the mandate of UNEF
  • 439 (1978) Elections in Namibia
  • 440 (1978) Urging the two communities in Cyprus to resume negotiations
  • 441 (1978) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 442 (1978) Admission of Dominica to membership in the United Nations
  • 443 (1978) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
